description: Update a document (partial). Stamps updated_at. Also files a document against a record after the fact: pass entity + entity_id together (both, never one) to attach a previously unfiled upload once you know where it belongs, or both as null to detach it again. The target record is checked against the tenant first.

document_id.description: ID of the document to change

entity.description: File it against a record: lead|contact|account|campaign|user|asbest_project|raumbuchung_booking. Pass together with entity_id, or both null to detach.

entity_id.description: Record id — always together with entity.

url.description: New external link of the document

name: update_document
